en: Black‑and‑white landscape view over a grassy park or meadow toward a European town. In the foreground are trees and a path with simple railings. Beyond the open field stands a dense cluster of brick buildings, several tall factory chimneys, and at least two ornate church towers with baroque or late‑renaissance style domes and spires. One large industrial building on the right has a high smokestack and rows of arched windows. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial cityscape, printed as a photographic postcard with a wide white sky and no visible caption on the front.
